name: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
short_description: Azure Kubernetes Service is Microsoft's managed Kubernetes offering: Microsoft runs the control plane, while customers choose and pay for the worker node virtual machines that run their containers.

evidence.quote: AKS is Microsoft's managed version of Kubernetes.
Microsoft runs the control plane for you and handles the upgrades, patches, and backups.
Azure Kubernetes service gives you complete control over everything.
Flux is the default GitOps option on Azure Kubernetes service.
